environment.description: Kubernetes deployment with Kong API gateway in DB-less mode. The gateway performs JWT authentication and rate limiting but does NOT enforce request body schema validation. The /api/v1/events endpoint is exposed directly through a KongIngress resource with strip-path enabled. Kafka topic 'notifications' has no message-level schema registry enforcement (no Confluent Schema Registry). The Go service runs as a non-root container but with no seccomp profile restricting syscalls.
